name: Kissing At Age 16
overview: Scripture portrays kissing as an expression of affection, trust, and covenant relationship, seen in personal interactions like Orpah's farewell to her mother-in-law and symbolic acts such as the union of mercy and truth. The Psalms highlight the spiritual significance of kissing the Son, urging believers to embrace Christ to avoid wrath. Proverbs emphasizes the value of truthful speech and open correction, suggesting that genuine love and integrity are foundational to relationships. Together, these verses encourage thoughtful, sincere expressions of love and commitment within God's design.
